messages.text: Rise of Espanyol's English winger Dolan: 'I am not the player I was a year ago'

metadata.summary: Tyrhys Dolan made an explosive start to the season in LaLiga with a goal in Espanyol’s 3-0 win over Levante. The English forward looked particularly sharp. Something has changed. “I am not the person or player I was a year ago,” Dolan tells Sky Sports.
metadata.content: Tyrhys Dolan interview: Espanyol winger scored against Levante in LaLiga opener and is ready to face Real Madrid next | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Exclusive Tyrhys Dolan interview: Espanyol winger scored against Levante in LaLiga opener and is ready to face Real Madrid next In this exclusive interview with Sky Sports , Tyrhys Dolan discusses his goalscoring start to the season for Espanyol in LaLiga and the reasons for his improvement. The 24-year-old Englishman will be up against Jose Mourinho's Real Madrid on Saturday evening... Adam Bate Football Features Writer @ghostgoal Friday 21 August 2026 11:21, UK Image: Espanyol forward Tyrhys Dolan made a scoring start to the season in LaLiga against Levante Tyrhys Dolan made an explosive start to the season in LaLiga with a goal in Espanyol’s 3-0 win over Levante. The English forward looked particularly sharp. Something has changed. “I am not the person or player I was a year ago,” Dolan tells Sky Sports . His first year in Spanish football after leaving Championship club Blackburn Rovers had its moments. He played against Real Madrid and Barcelona. But there is more to come, he insists. "I know the league now. I know myself a lot more. I know what I can do." There is a reason for his optimism. Dolan spent much of last season operating on the right wing. "Pretty much on the touchline. Hanging wide." His job was to cross the ball and his numbers reflected that. "My assist output was much better than my goal output.

metadata.summary: Tottenham Hotspur have agreed an £85m deal with Manchester City to sign Savinho.
metadata.content: Savinho transfer: Spurs agree £85m deal to sign Brazil forward from Manchester City | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Transfer Savinho transfer: Spurs agree £85m deal to sign Brazil forward from Manchester City Savinho is set to undergo a medical ahead of a an £85m move to Tottenham Hotspur from Manchester City; Spurs have already spent more than £200m this summer on six first-team players; Savinho started in seven of his 24 Premier League appearances last season By Lyall Thomas and Michael Bridge Friday 21 August 2026 14:35, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Sky Sporyts' Michael Bridge re-vosts the question that was asked at the start of the transfer window - how can Sppurs afford all these players? Tottenham Hotspur have agreed an £85m deal with Manchester City to sign Savinho. Spurs will pay an initial £75m for the Brazil international, with a further £10m available in add-ons. It is understood that £5m of the potential bonuses are effectively guaranteed, meaning City could receive at least £80m from the deal.
